comments.author: RebarBotNava
comments.body:
ROOT CAUSE PROVEN; fix identified but BLOCKED on module size. Not landed.

WHY THE FALSE POSITIVE HAPPENS
compact.py's NORMAL compaction path builds its source list as:
    source_uuids = [u for (_fp, u, _ts) in old]          (compact.py ~line 299)
`old` is filtered from `parsed`, and `parsed` admits every file whose event_type is in
KNOWN_EVENT_TYPES — which INCLUDES SNAPSHOT (compact.py 219-233). So when compaction folds a
ticket, the SUPERSEDED SNAPSHOT is itself listed in the new snapshot's source_event_uuids.
fsck then requires every cited source to exist on disk, and reports the ticket as damaged once
that older snapshot is gone.

The REBUILD path already does the right thing — it explicitly skips snapshots when building
its source list (`if base.endswith("-SNAPSHOT.json"): continue`). So the two paths disagree,
and the normal path is the wrong one.

WHY ONLY 6 LIVE TICKETS ARE AFFECTED
Post-I1 (story tricolour-head-ratfish) compaction RETIRES what it folds, so the superseded
snapshot file still exists as *.retired and snapshot_missing_sources counts it present. Only
PRE-I1 tickets — where the folded snapshot was DELETED — can hit this. It is a legacy-data
artifact, not an ongoing one.

THE FIX (small, and it makes the two paths agree)
Exclude folded snapshots from source_uuids in the normal path:
    source_uuids = [u for (_fp, u, _ts) in old
                    if not basename(_fp).removesuffix(RETIRED_SUFFIX).endswith('-SNAPSHOT.json')]
The 6 affected tickets then self-heal on their next compaction — no data migration needed.
Implemented and lint/complexity-clean in worktree ../aea0-snapshot-false-positive.

WHY IT IS NOT PUSHED
compact.py is 796 lines against the HARD 800-line module-size cap. The fix plus its
explanatory comment is +9 lines, so it does not fit. I trimmed the comment three times and
stopped: compressing the rationale to satisfy a line budget is the wrong trade, and the same
squeeze already forced a split in fsck_repair earlier today (85fa, change 1577).

DECISION NEEDED: compact.py needs a module-size split before this can land. That is a bigger,
riskier refactor of a core module than the one-line fix it unblocks, so it should be a
deliberate choice rather than something smuggled in under a P2 cosmetic bug. Candidate seam:
the normal-compaction orchestration (_compact_locked) vs the CLI entrypoints
(compact_cli / compact_all_cli / _scan_snapshot_state).

comments.body:
FIX LANDED FOR REVIEW — Gerrit change 1587, stacked on 1586 (the b2bb split that unblocked it).

The fix is the one identified in the prior session's root-cause comment, applied to
_compact_locked in its new home (compact_txn.py, which has real headroom now):
source_uuids skips any folded file whose basename — after stripping RETIRED_SUFFIX — ends
in -SNAPSHOT.json. The normal path now agrees with the rebuild path, which already skipped
snapshots.

HELD-OUT TEST — tests/interfaces/lifecycle/test_snapshot_source_uuids_aea0.py
Asserts BOTH directions, because AC3 requires the b636 guard not be weakened:
  1. compact twice; the second SNAPSHOT must NOT cite the first SNAPSHOT's uuid, and must
     still cite the raw event folded in the same pass (no over-correction);
  2. delete a retired RAW source a snapshot cites — fsck must STILL report
     SNAPSHOT_MISSING_SOURCES.

PROVEN by reverting the single expression to its old form: assertion 1 fails with 'the
superseded SNAPSHOT was cited as a source event', assertion 2 passes UNCHANGED in both
states. That is the evidence that the change is targeted at the false positive and does not
loosen the truncated-log guard.

AC STATUS
- [x] snapshot_missing_sources no longer counts a cited uuid whose event is a superseded
      SNAPSHOT. Determined WITHOUT a history walk — the compactor already knows which files
      it is folding, so the filename suffix is authoritative at that point.
- [ ] The six listed tickets report clean afterwards, status unchanged. NOT YET VERIFIABLE:
      they self-heal on their NEXT compaction, which cannot happen until 1587 merges and the
      local build picks it up. Re-check with fsck after it lands before closing.
- [x] A genuinely missing raw event is still reported — held-out test, both directions.
- [ ] 'Consider recording the folded snapshot uuid distinctly in the SNAPSHOT payload so the
      distinction is structural rather than inferred.' NOT DONE, deliberately: it is a
      payload/schema change affecting every future snapshot, and the filename suffix is
      already authoritative at fold time. Worth its own ticket if the structural form is
      wanted; it is not needed to fix this bug.

DO NOT CLOSE until 1587 is Verified +1 and merged, and the six tickets are re-checked.

compiled_state.description:
# A folded prior SNAPSHOT is not a lost event

`fsck_repair.snapshot_missing_sources` flags any cited `source_event_uuids` entry with no
file on disk. But when compaction folds a ticket, the SUPERSEDED SNAPSHOT is itself listed as
a source of its successor, and that snapshot file is then legitimately gone — consumed. No
data is lost: a snapshot's entire content IS its `compiled_state`, which the successor
absorbed.

Treating that as an incomplete log is wrong twice over: it reports a healthy ticket as
damaged, and (post b636) it makes the ticket look un-rebuildable.

## Evidence
After the b636 remediation, 6 tickets still report SNAPSHOT_MISSING_SOURCES:
316c-6c42-32d3-4f9b, a6ea-6a28-1d84-4626, bbc0-1dbd-d9cb-4917, be08-b46d-51be-419d,
c7c5-12ea-ad68-4690, e0d4-4f19-699d-4d61.
Each is missing EXACTLY ONE uuid, and in every case that uuid resolves (via the path it was
added at in tickets history) to a `-SNAPSHOT.json` event. All six reduce to `closed`
correctly — their state is intact. The 7th (f130) was a genuine EDIT loss and was repaired
separately.

## Acceptance criteria
- [ ] `snapshot_missing_sources` does NOT count a cited uuid whose event is a SNAPSHOT
      superseded by the citing snapshot. Determine the type without a history walk where
      possible (the reducer/compaction knows which uuid was the folded snapshot).
- [ ] The six tickets above report clean afterwards, with their status unchanged.
- [ ] A genuinely missing raw event is still reported (no weakening of the b636 guard) —
      held-out test asserts both directions.
- [ ] Consider recording the folded snapshot uuid distinctly in the SNAPSHOT payload so the
      distinction is structural rather than inferred.
compiled_state.title: SNAPSHOT_MISSING_SOURCES false-positives when the missing source is a consumed prior SNAPSHOT
